messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc:
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage consolidation & QBR review-pack schedule (Aug -> Sep commit)

Team —

We need to consolidate stage updates for all Q3 commit candidates and lock the leadership review pack by next Wednesday (9/8). Goal: deliver a single PDF deck + commit tracker to Finance and Execs that shows stage, ARR, primary blocker, and ask.

Please do the following by EOD Monday (9/6):
- Owners: fill the commit_tracker_template.xlsx (attached) with every open opportunity >= $15k ARR; include a single-line rationale for stage (e.g., "value prop signed, awaiting PO").
- Stage hygiene: move any deals that are actually lost into Closed-Lost, and flag stalled deals with an "owner-action" date.
- Attach any outstanding security or legal blockers as filenames under the "evidence" column (not the entire docs).

I'll compile all inputs Tues morning, run a quick scrub with Laura & Karthik, and then build the review pack for leadership on Wed. Monica — please hold 30m Tue 10:00-10:30 for the scrub.

External heads-up: Sarah at Acme is scheduled for a check-in on 9/7; I will confirm the commit status after internal scrub.

Attachments: commit_tracker_template.xlsx

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage consolidation & QBR review-pack schedule (Aug -> Sep commit)

Jordan —

Thanks for the timeline. Confirming I will:
- Run a stage pass for all west-coast accounts this morning and update the tracker by 1pm PT.
- Look specifically for any deals sitting in "Legal Review" >30 days and flag progress steps.

One note: I have two opportunities that look like marketing-led renewals (low ARR) that clutter the commit view — shall I remove anything < $15k ARR or leave so ops can see volume?

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage consolidation & QBR review-pack schedule (Aug -> Sep commit)

Quick q's:
1) Template: is the ask column expected to be dollar value or a specific action item (PO/Contract signed)? I'd prefer action item + amount to keep it actionable in the pack.
2) Leadership pack: will we include win probabilities? If yes, Ops wants a separate sheet so we do not bias the exec readout.

I'll be on the scrub Tue with you, Jordan. Also looping Finance to ensure the ARR definitions match what they'll expect in the QBR.

-Karthik
Director, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage consolidation & QBR review-pack schedule (Aug -> Sep commit)

Laura — remove deals < $15k ARR from the leadership pack (but keep them in the ops sheet).

Karthik — put both: action ask (PO/Signature) and the $ amount in the same cell separated by a pipe (e.g., "PO requested | $25,000"). For the deck, we'll show ARR and the ask briefly; Ops will get the secondary sheet with probabilities and raw notes.

Monica — confirm Tue 10:00 scrub is still good; I'll share a compiled PDF by Tue 18:00 so you can prep the review notes.

Jordan
From: Sarah Liang <sarah.liang@acme.com>

Best,
Sarah Liang

Acme Corp
